description: This PHP source file defines a data access object (DAO) class ResetPasswordDao within the OrangeHRM project. The class provides methods to handle reset password requests, including saving requests, retrieving them by email or reset code, and updating validation status.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling reset password requests in the database.

methods.name: saveResetPasswordRequest
methods.description: Saves a ResetPasswordRequest entity to the database.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent ResetPasswordRequest for a given email.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ResetPasswordRequest entity by its reset code.

methods.name: updateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of reset password requests associated with a specific email.
